onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.title: Permissions required
permissions.description: Felix needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: Felix shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Dictate
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Dictate with a prompt
transcribe_with_post_process.description: A second shortcut that runs one of your own prompts over the dictation.

meeting.name: Start or stop a meeting
meeting.description: Starts or stops recording a meeting, in the mode you used last. Not set by default.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Hold or tap
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Models
models.description: What turns your voice into text and tidies it up — on this Mac or in the cloud.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Felix

sections.transcriptionDescription: These turn your voice into text on this Mac.
sections.cleanupDescription: These tidy up each dictation on this Mac, with nothing sent to the cloud. Downloading one installs Ollama too if it’s missing.

qwen4b.name: Qwen3.5 4B
qwen4b.description: Most accurate. Keeps your wording and facts; about 0.3 s per cleanup.

qwen2b.name: Qwen3.5 2B
qwen2b.description: About half the memory of the 4B and a bit faster, but a little less careful. For Macs with 16 GB of memory or less, or a base M-series chip.

cleanup.deleteConfirm: Delete {{model}}? You can download it again later.

where.title: What runs where
where.description: This Mac is private and free; the cloud is lighter on your Mac. If a cloud service fails, dictation falls back to this Mac.
where.macAll: This Mac ({{chip}}, {{memory}} GB) runs speech-to-text and cleanup well on its own.
where.macSpeech: This Mac ({{chip}}, {{memory}} GB) runs speech-to-text well; for cleanup the cloud is faster and uses less memory.
where.macCloud: This Mac ({{chip}}, {{memory}} GB) is better off using the cloud for both.
where.chatgptModel: Luna is fastest and is enough for cleanup.

speech.title: Speech to text
speech.description: Cloud providers get the dictation's audio and your vocabulary as a spelling hint.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Tidies what you said. Cloud providers get the text, plus what’s on screen only if you allow it under Writing.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Connect a service once and speech, cleanup, meetings and Felix can all use it. Keys stay on this Mac.

channel.title: Input channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Start and stop sounds
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Play sounds on
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

autoGain.label: Automatic gain
autoGain.description: Boosts quiet speech (whispering, clip-on or distant mics) before silence detection, up to +30 dB, without lifting room noise.

inputGain.title: Input gain
inputGain.description: Fixed boost or cut applied to the microphone before transcription.

preferredMicrophones.title: Preferred microphones
preferredMicrophones.description: Used in this order whenever they're connected, ahead of the Microphone setting above and the system default. Disconnected ones stay on the list, and Felix switches back automatically when they return.

startHidden.label: Start in the background
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Open at login
autostart.description: Automatically start Felix when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show in the menu bar
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Felix icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Free up memory
modelUnload.description: Unload the speech model when you haven’t dictated for a while. The next dictation takes a moment longer.

customWords.title: Custom words
customWords.description: Names and jargon the speech model should favor while it transcribes (Whisper's prompt, Qwen3-ASR's context, or tuned keyword boosting for Cohere and Canary-Qwen). Technical terms with digits, dashes or several capitals, like GLM-5.3, are also rewritten to your exact spelling when they come out as "GLM 5.3" or "G L M five point three".

voiceActivityDetection.title: Skip silence
voiceActivityDetection.description: Leave out silence before sending audio to the speech model. Turning this off records everything.

vadBackend.title: Silence detector
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove filler words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

textReplacements.title: Replacements
textReplacements.description: Rules applied to the raw transcript before voice commands and AI cleanup. Plain text matches whole words, ignoring case ("cube cuddle" → "kubectl"). Wrap a rule in slashes for a regex: /\bcasp[ae]r\b/ → Sam; use $1 for capture groups.
textReplacements.duplicate: There is already a replacement for "{{from}}"

contextAwarePaste.label: Fit to surrounding text
contextAwarePaste.description: Before pasting, look at the text around the cursor: add a space after a word or punctuation, and lowercase the first word when continuing a sentence. Works in fields that expose their text to Accessibility.

resultPopup.label: Show text when there's nowhere to paste
resultPopup.description: If no text field is focused when a dictation finishes, show it in a card instead of pasting, with a Copy button. Apps whose text fields can't be detected (terminals, some editors) always get the paste.
resultPopup.timeoutDescription: How long the card stays up. Moving the pointer over it pauses the countdown.

focusMessageBox.label: Find the message box
focusMessageBox.description: In Claude, Codex and WhatsApp, if no text box has the cursor, the dictation goes into the thread's message box (not a terminal or search field).

api.title: API (OpenAI compatible)

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionLocal: qwen3.5:4b is the most accurate. qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M needs about half the memory but is a bit less careful. Any Ollama model or a path to a .gguf file also works.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

api.movedToModels: Change the cleanup model and its account under Models.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click “Create new prompt” above to write your first one.

cleanup.title: How much to tidy
cleanup.description: Runs after your vocabulary and voice commands, and before the tone for the app you’re in.
cleanup.intro: If an edit would change the meaning, drop details or invent numbers, Felix throws it away and pastes the plain transcript instead.

none.title: None
none.description: Transcribes what you said, with only your vocabulary and correction rules applied.
none.example: yeah so I was thinking we could we could grab dinner at like seven no actually eight since Sam's running late

light.title: Light
light.description: Removes fillers and repeats, applies self-corrections, fixes punctuation and numbers. Keeps your wording.
light.example: Yeah, so I was thinking we could grab dinner at 8 since Sam's running late.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: Light, plus tightens phrasing for clarity while keeping every detail.
medium.example: We could grab dinner at 8, since Sam's running late.

instructions.title: Your instructions
instructions.description: Your own rules, one per line. Felix follows them while tidying, and they win over the level above.
instructions.needsClarity: Pick Light or Medium above to use your instructions; None skips the AI entirely.
instructions.placeholder:
e.g. Use British spelling
Never use exclamation marks

examples.personal: e.g. Keep it short and friendly
examples.work: e.g. Spell product names exactly as in my vocabulary
examples.other: e.g. Keep technical terms and code exactly as spoken

shortcut.title: Dictate with a prompt
shortcut.description: A second shortcut that runs one of your own prompts instead of the usual tidy-up — handy for translating or summarising a dictation.

local.title: Local model
local.ready: {{model}} is installed and runs on this Mac.
local.needsOllama: Install Ollama and download {{model}} to clean up dictations on this Mac, with nothing sent to the cloud.
local.needsModel: Download {{model}} to clean up dictations on this Mac.

keepLoaded.label: Keep model loaded
keepLoaded.description: Keeps the model in memory (about 3–4 GB for the default model) so cleanup starts instantly.
keepLoaded.warning: The model will load when you start dictating and unload after it's idle. Expect slower cleanup, especially on short dictations, but less memory in use.

screenContext.title: What’s on screen
screenContext.label: Use what's on screen
screenContext.description: Cleanup sees the conversation above the text box and your draft (read through Accessibility, no screenshots), so it spells names, files and code the way they appear. Password managers are never read.
screenContext.onlineDescription: Send that screen text to your online cleanup provider too. Off: it's only used with the model on this Mac.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Hold your shortcut and start talking.
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

retention.textDescription: How long dictated text stays on the History page. Starred entries are always kept.
retention.audioDescription: Audio is only needed to replay or re-transcribe a dictation. Off by default; nothing is written to disk when set to Don't keep.
retention.noAudioForEntry: No audio was kept for this dictation

history.description: Everything you’ve dictated, newest first. Star the ones worth keeping.

logDirectory.title: Logs folder
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Felix

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview what's new
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-delete recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Tidy up my words
postProcessingToggle.description: An AI model cleans up each dictation before it’s pasted. Also turns on the prompt shortcut below.

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append trailing space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

pasteDelay.title: Paste delay (before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste delay (after)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable paste (beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra recording buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Felix. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Felix normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show what's new
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Felix updates

appDataDirectory.title: Felix’s folder
appDataDirectory.description: Where Felix keeps your history, recordings and rules

sourceCode.title: Built on Handy
sourceCode.description: Felix is a fork of Handy by CJ Pais and contributors, a free and open source dictation app

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Felix's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

toggle.label: Listen for commands
toggle.description: Turns on everything on this page: trigger phrases, “new line” and “new paragraph”, and spoken flags like “dash dash force”.

triggers.groupDescription: End a dictation with a trigger phrase to press a key after pasting. Say "new line" or "new paragraph" anywhere to break lines. Matching ignores capitalization and punctuation, and runs before cleanup.
triggers.title: Trigger phrases
triggers.description: Phrases that, said at the very end of a dictation, are removed and replaced by a key press after the paste.

assistant.warning: Off by default. When it's on, saying the assistant's name sends that dictation and the text in the field to ChatGPT and lets it rewrite or replace what's in the field. Acting on your Mac is a separate switch below. Turn it on once you're comfortable with that.
assistant.groupDescription: Say the assistant's name anywhere in a dictation to hand it to a ChatGPT model: "my email is Felix put my email here", "Felix, reply saying I'm in", or select text and say "Felix, make this shorter". The dictation and the text in the field are sent to ChatGPT.
assistant.toggleDescription: Listen for the assistant's name in dictations.

account.title: ChatGPT account
account.description: Uses your ChatGPT subscription. The sign-in is saved in a file only your Mac account can read.

name.title: Name
name.description: The word that calls the assistant, anywhere in a dictation. Pick one you don't otherwise say.
name.invalid: The name must be a single word
name.tips: Jarvis, Marvin and Cosmo were heard correctly by every speech model in testing and are rarely said by accident. Now that the app is called Felix, a name other than Felix avoids calling the assistant when you talk about the app.

model.title: Model
model.description: Sol writes best; Luna is faster.

effort.title: Thinking
effort.description: More thinking handles harder requests but takes longer.

computer.groupDescription: "Felix, open Notes and start a packing list" works your apps in the background through Codex and Cua Driver. It won't send, post, delete or buy anything; it gets things ready and tells you. "Felix, open Claude Code and start a new project that…" creates the project folder in Documents/Agent Work and opens a Claude Code session there with your request. Needs Codex CLI signed in to ChatGPT, and Accessibility and Screen Recording access for Felix.

toggle.label: Act on your Mac
toggle.description: Off by default. Lets the assistant start Claude Code sessions and do tasks in your other apps. Off, it only writes into the field you're dictating into.

autoSend.label: Send the first message
autoSend.description: Send the request as soon as the session opens. Off leaves it filled in for you to check and send.

fastMode.label: Fast mode (very experimental)
fastMode.description: Very experimental and mostly untested; expect it to click the wrong thing. Simple Jev (Featherless's classifier) picks each click, about a second per step, and Codex takes over anything it can't finish. The names of buttons and fields in that app, and the text you asked for, go to Simple Jev's public demo.

notes.title: About you
notes.description: Details the assistant can fill in when you ask, such as your name, email, phone number, address and how you sign off emails.
notes.placeholder:
Name: ...
Email: ...
Signs off emails with: ...

voiceControl.title: Voice commands
voiceControl.description: Say “new line” or end with “press enter”. Commands run before cleanup.

report.title: Report a mistake
report.description: Describe it, like “it wrote cube control instead of kubectl”, or tell Felix while dictating. ChatGPT (your Felix sign-in) writes a fix and tests it, using your last few dictations; you see the change before it’s applied. Felix applies safe fixes right away.
report.saved: Saved. It applies from your next dictation.
report.needsCode: Rules alone can't fully fix this; it needs a change to Felix.
report.invalid: The suggested file has a mistake: {{error}}

biasing.title: Biasing
biasing.description: Stage 1: words the speech model should favor while transcribing. Technical terms are also snapped to your exact spelling afterwards.

rules.title: Correction rules
rules.description: Stage 2, on the raw transcript: fixed rewrites for anything the model still gets wrong. Runs before voice commands and AI cleanup.

teach.title: Teach a word
teach.description: Say a vocabulary word a few times, spoken and whispered. The clips are kept so the word can be re-checked automatically whenever you switch transcription models; mishearings are rewritten to the word.
teach.dialogDescription: Each take goes through the same path as a real dictation: your current model with biasing, then your correction rules.
teach.allRecognized: "{{word}}" came through correctly every time. The clips are saved so it gets re-checked if you switch models.
teach.commonWord: common word: would also rewrite normal speech

taught.title: Taught words
taught.recognized: Recognized correctly on the current model.

learned.title: What Felix has learned
learned.description: Words, corrections and sound-alikes from your reports. Words also help the speech model hear them. Remove anything that's wrong.
learned.empty: Nothing yet. Report a mistake above and the fix appears here.
learned.soundalike: {{heard}} → {{word}}, when the sentence means the name
learned.fileError: The rules file has a mistake, so the last good version is used: {{error}}

reports.title: Your reports
reports.description: Every mistake you reported, with the speech model that made it. The dictation's audio is kept on this Mac so other models can be tested on the same mistakes.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Tell Felix what it got wrong, in your own words. It writes a rule, tests it and remembers.

formality.title: Formality
formality.description: Capitalization and punctuation for each kind of app. Applied last, after AI cleanup, so it's always honored.

example.formal: Hey, are you free for lunch tomorrow? Let's do 12 if that works for you.
example.casual: Hey are you free for lunch tomorrow? Let's do 12 if that works for you
example.very_casual: hey are you free for lunch tomorrow? let's do 12 if that works for you

apps.addSiteDescription: For a site not listed: its domain (subdomains match too). Websites are detected in Safari, Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge and Vivaldi; macOS asks once per browser.
apps.moreApps_one: …and {{count}} other app. Search to find it.
apps.moreApps_other: …and {{count}} other apps. Search to find them.

style.title: Tone by app
style.intro: Apps and websites are sorted into groups automatically, each with its own tone. Click an app to move it.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.description: Hold a key, talk, let go. Here’s how Felix listens and where your words end up.

language.title: Language
language.description: Options for {{model}}, the speech model you’re using.

groups.listeningDescription: How Felix tells speech from silence. The defaults suit most people.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: How your words come out: how much Felix tidies them, what it should always do, and the tone for each app.

app.title: Settings
app.description: How Felix starts, looks and behaves on your Mac.

groups.developersDescription: For testing and improving Felix itself. You don’t need these for everyday use.

benchmark.label: Benchmark recording
benchmark.description: Keeps every dictation’s unprocessed audio (before gain and silence skipping) with what was transcribed, what was pasted and your edits to it, so settings and models can be compared on your real speech later. Everything stays on this Mac. Uses about 2 MB a minute of speech.

review.title: Ground truth
review.description: What you actually said, for {{confirmed}} of {{count}} · {{guessed}} with an AI guess
review.intro: Listen, then write what you actually said, word for word with every um and repeat. The AI guess only fixes obviously misheard words; check it before using it.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Felix needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

appLanguage.title: Language
appLanguage.description: The language Felix’s own screens are shown in

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Choose whether Felix follows your system theme or stays light or dark

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

meetings.heading: Meetings
meetings.subheading: Record calls and in-person meetings on your Mac. Nothing joins the call.
meetings.empty: No meetings yet. Start one above, from the menu bar, or with the meeting shortcut.

mode.callHint: Your mic, plus the other people from your Mac's audio.
mode.inPersonHint: Just the mic, for a meeting in the room.

transcriber.title: Transcribe with
transcriber.description: This Mac uses your dictation model, and nothing leaves the Mac. OpenAI and Groq use the API key from Models → Accounts.

diarize.label: Tell speakers apart
diarize.description: In person, label who's talking (Speaker 1, Speaker 2…). Downloads a 26.5 MB voice model the first time.

autoGain.label: Raise quiet voices
autoGain.description: In person, bring people further from the mic up to a clear level before transcribing. Doesn't change dictation.

boost.label: Meeting mic boost
boost.description: Extra fixed gain for in-person recordings, before levelling. Doesn't change dictation.

llm.title: Summarise with
llm.description: ChatGPT uses your Felix sign-in. Cleanup model uses the provider and model chosen for dictation cleanup.

cleanup.label: Tidy the transcript
cleanup.description: Fix punctuation, false starts and misheard words before summarising. The original is kept.

prompt.title: What to put in the notes
prompt.description: Leave empty for the default, shown faded. Your notes and the transcript are always included.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.placeholder: Write notes as you go. They'll be combined with the transcript when the meeting is summarised.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: No speech was found in this recording.
transcript.afterRecording: The transcript appears here after you stop recording.

summary.title: Notes
summary.afterTranscript: Notes are written once the transcript is done.
